rawContent: @AdamBKushner I saw Tarana Burke speak to a room of Black women once and she mentioned that everytime she would talk to a mixed crowd of people about #MeToo and bring up the experiences of women of color, white women would come up to her afterward and complain that they felt left out.

@rmrphoto @CBSNews I was just thinking, imagine if these were interviews from a #BlackLivesMatter rally? Another thing Trump's presidency has done is shine a spotlight on America's complacency with white supremacy and its inherent (and now explicit!) threats of violence.
